name: Nexus
description:
Nexus is a workout, meal, and body-weight log that lives inside the chat.

Say 'bench 4x8 at 80kg' or 'two eggs and toast' and it's logged — Claude estimates the calories and macros, Nexus keeps the record. Ask what you ate yesterday, how your bench is progressing, or whether you hit protein this week, and the answer comes from your actual history.

Every day gets one card: calories against your goal, macros, and workouts with PRs flagged. Correct anything by saying so ('that was 90kg, not 80'). Set daily calorie and protein targets once and every day is measured against them.

There's also a small social layer: add friends with a code and see each other's daily cards for accountability.

Sign in with Google or email. Free.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nexus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nexus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://claude-mcp.nexus.kushalsm.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nexus MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nexus provides these MCP tools: nexus_get_history, nexus_log_entries, nexus_manage_friends, nexus_set_goal, and nexus_update_entry.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nexus?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Nexus in consumer-health on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sweat & Tonic, Vitals Vault, It's Complicated — Therapist Directory, courtsapp, and CheckCells.
Nexus requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nexus is developed by Kushal. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
